title: Why your knees CRACK when you squat 🦴
caption:
Usually it's a gas bubble forming in your joint fluid as the joint opens. Painless cracking is common. Pain or swelling? Get it checked. Do your knees crack? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #3
first_comment: Knees, back, knuckles: which one cracks the loudest? 😅
sources: Kawchuk GN et al. Real-time visualization of joint cavitation. PLoS One 2015;10:e0119470 (MRI: cavity forms at the moment of the crack)

Robertson CJ, Hurley M, Jones F. People's beliefs about the meaning of crepitus in patellofemoral pain and the impact of these beliefs on their behaviour. Musculoskelet Sci Pract 2017;28:59-64 (crepitus is common, including in people without pain)
De Oliveira Silva D et al. Knee crepitus is prevalent in women with patellofemoral pain, but is not related with function, physical activity and pain. Phys Ther Sport 2018;33:7-11
